The simulation ran, but the result carries a finding I need to surface rather than gloss over: **all nine emitted rows are `append` — no `upsert` or `retract` ever appears**, even though the retraction logic *did* execute. Let me verify why with a controlled variant.

```python
# ---- DIAGNOSTIC: same events, evt-007 moved later in the arrival order ----
# BASE had evt-007 (et=00:06:00) at arrival 3, when the watermark in force was
# only 00:01:30 -> window [00:00,00:02) had NOT yet fired. The retraction was
# applied before the window's first publish, so it silently netted to zero.
# Move it after evt-005 (which lifts max_et to 00:04:05 -> wm 00:03:35) so the
# window fires FIRST and the correction lands as a true revision.
VARIANT = [
    (1,  "evt-003", "P3", "7.25",   "2025-01-01T00:02:00Z"),
    (2,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),
    (3,  "evt-002", "P2", "25.50",  "2025-01-01T00:01:15Z"),
    (4,  "evt-005", "P2", "4.99",   "2025-01-01T00:04:05Z"),
    (5,  "evt-007", "P1", "-10.00", "2025-01-01T00:06:00Z"),   # <-- moved to 5
    (6,  "evt-004", "P1", "12.00",  "2025-01-01T00:03:20Z"),
    (7,  "evt-010", "P3", "21.10",  "2025-01-01T00:08:55Z"),
    (8,  "evt-006", "P3", "8.75",   "2025-01-01T00:05:10Z"),
    (9,  "evt-009", "P3", "3.50",   "2025-01-01T00:07:30Z"),
    (10, "evt-008", "P2", "15.00",  "2025-01-01T00:06:45Z"),
    (11, "evt-011", "P2", "6.40",   "2025-01-01T00:09:40Z"),
]

em2, _, _ = simulate(VARIANT)
d2 = pd.DataFrame(em2)
print("VARIANT EMISSIONS".center(110, "="))
print(d2.assign(window=lambda d: d.window_start.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S") + "–"
                                + d.window_end.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
                total_revenue=lambda d: d.total_revenue.map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}"))
      [["at","src","product_id","window","total_revenue","output_mode","trigger"]].to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "timing check (why BASE produced no retract row)".center(110, "="))
for label, arr, et, wmq in [("BASE  evt-007", 3, "00:06:00", "00:01:30"),
                            ("VARIANT evt-007", 5, "00:06:00", "00:03:35")]:
    fired = wmq >= "00:02:00"
    print(f"  {label:<16} arrival={arr}  et={et}  watermark_in_force={wmq}  "
          f"window[00:00,00:02) fired already? {fired}  -> "
          f"{'RETRACT of published row' if fired else 'nets to 0 BEFORE first publish (no row)'}")
print("\nBASE modes:", d2_modes if False else pd.DataFrame(em).output_mode.value_counts().to_dict(),
      "| VARIANT modes:", d2.output_mode.value_counts().to_dict())
```
